Published Algorithm Specifications and PDD Rates (v1.2.0)

rates_published.Rd

The version of rates distributed with demcrit v1.2.0, i.e., the values printed in Mana et al. (2026). In these data, MoCA-based algorithms applied the global criterion MoCA < 26, although Table 1 of the article states MoCA < 27. Kept for comparison only; use rates for analyses. See vignette("corrections") for details.

Usage

rates_published

Format

A tibble with the same structure as rates.

Source

demcrit v1.2.0 (commit 1843263).

See also

rates for the corrected data.
